notes.title: Buy our Booklet to support the Devs!
notes.content: [p][b]Welcome, explorers of NA-Re![/b][/p][p]Today, we've made a small [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331920/NARe_Supporters_Booklet"]booklet[/url] available on Steam — previously it was only shared at offline events and as part of an online puzzle. [/p][p]Inside, you'll find character concepts and get a closer look at the angelic girls in high resolution![/p][p]By [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331920/NARe_Supporters_Booklet"]purchasing the booklet[/url], you're supporting the developers and publishers of [b]NA-Re: great chain of being[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331920/NARe_Supporters_Booklet"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240202/f687553e8f0b7b10f9c8744e9b51ae5c366881af.png"][/img][/p]
